finalText:
Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections at 02:14:07. That is the root cause.

Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store then timed out on nearly every call. All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`, so Redis never came back.

Queue depth passed its max of 500 at 02:29:12. `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at 02:31:44. The supervisor killed the api group at 02:31:52.
